description: This file defines extension methods for the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically for adding and configuring broadcast channels within the Orleans silo and client builders. It includes methods to register broadcast channel providers with custom options, retrieve providers by name, and manages dependencies related to broadcast channels.

classes.name: ChannelHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for adding broadcast channel support to Orleans silo and client builders.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel
methods.description: Adds a broadcast channel to the Orleans silo builder with specified options.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel
methods.description: Adds a broadcast channel to the Orleans silo builder with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel
methods.description: Adds a broadcast channel to the Orleans client builder with specified options.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel
methods.description: Adds a broadcast channel to the Orleans client builder with optional configuration.

methods.name: GetBroadcastChannelProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a named broadcast channel provider from the cluster client.
